mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2% year-over-year signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns remain positive or neutral in periods of high inflation (CPIAUCSL YoY > 2%) over a 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 4% signals a tightening labor market, leading to wage inflation and increased production costs, which negatively impacts S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns remain positive or neutral in periods of low unemployment (UNRATE < 4%) over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in Real Personal Consumption Expenditures (RSAFS) signals strong consumer demand, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are negative or neutral during periods of increasing RSAFS over a 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in Industrial Production Index (INDPRO) signals a slowdown in economic activity, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns remain positive or neutral in periods of decreasing INDPRO over a 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in Nonfarm Payrolls (PAYEMS) combined with a decrease in the Unemployment Rate (UNRATE) signals a strong labor market, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are negative or neutral during periods of increasing PAYEMS and decreasing UNRATE over a 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the Federal Funds Rate (FEDFUNDS) signals a loosening monetary policy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns remain negative or neutral in periods of decreasing FEDFUNDS over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in Housing Starts (HOUST) signals strong demand in the housing market, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are negative or neutral during periods of increasing HOUST over a 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in Real GDP (GDPC1) signals a contraction in economic activity, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns remain positive or neutral in periods of decreasing GDPC1 over a 3-year rolling window.
